# Cncf Azure Api Management Reviewer

Review Azure API Management using its official documentation and repository in the Orchestration &amp; Management / API Gateway category. Azure API Management is a hybrid, multi-cloud API, full lifecycle management platform for APIs across all environments. It allows customers to self-host API gateways as containers on Kubernetes.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
